in_hebrew.name: אלנה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Elane is not found directly in the Bible, but it can be derived from the Hebrew roots 'El' (God) and 'Nana' (graciousness or favor).

in_greek.name: Ελανη
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Elane is not found directly in the Bible, but it can be derived from the Greek root 'Helios' (sun) and the suffix 'ana' (grace, shining).

in_latin.name: Elena
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Elane is 'Elena', which is derived from the Greek name 'Ελανη (Helanē)'. The name Helen in Latin means 'shining light' or 'bright'. It is not directly related to the Bible, but the name Helen appears in various works of literature and mythology.
